test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'certain'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the following noun **age.**
 
• For this purpose, the correct adjective is certain. 
 
• Certain means **"specific but not explicitly named or stated."**
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer. 

 

*Correct passage__ - **As the education of girls becomes similar (1) to that of boys, their home life will also become similar. Their present greater (2) knowledge of domestic affairs will also disappear. After a (3) __certain__ age, boys and girls should have a share in parental occupations and (4) anxieties, but not in excess as it would interfere with their education. Yet, (5) awareness of the problems of adult life helps boys and girls understand and appreciate the efforts of their parents.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• All other options are past tense verb forms.
 
• Fixed can be used as an adjective but it means (especially of a price, rate, or time) predetermined and not able to be changed.
